SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) WHERE M.STATUS IN ('Y', 'R', 'N')
AND M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND D.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND P.POSITION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ( (#{keyword} LIKE '%재%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'Y' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%휴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'R' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%퇴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%사%') AND M.STATUS = 'N' OR M.STATUS LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

SELECT M.MEMBER_ID , M.DEPARTMENT_ID , M.POSITION_ID , M.NAME , M.HIRE_DATE , M.STATUS , D.DEPARTMENT_NAME , P.POSITION_NAME FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON (M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID) LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON (M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID) WHERE M.STATUS IN ('Y', 'R', 'N')
AND M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND D.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND P.POSITION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ( (#{keyword} LIKE '%재%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'Y' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%휴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%직%') AND M.STATUS = 'R' OR (#{keyword} LIKE '%퇴%' OR #{keyword} LIKE '%사%') AND M.STATUS = 'N' OR M.STATUS LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY DECODE(TRIM(UPPER(M.STATUS)), 'Y', 1, 'R', 2, 'N', 3)
ASC DESC
ORDER BY D.DEPARTMENT_NAME
ASC DESC
ORDER BY M.POSITION_ID
ASC DESC
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID
ASC DESC
ORDER BY M.NAME
ASC DESC
ORDER BY M.HIRE_DATE
ASC DESC
ORDER BY M.MEMBER_ID DESC
